scripts.lint: biome check . && uv run --project pipeline ruff check pipeline && uv run --project pipeline ruff format --check pipeline
scripts.format: biome format --write . && uv run --project pipeline ruff format pipeline
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r typecheck && uv run --directory pipeline basedpyright
scripts.test: pnpm -r test && uv run --project pipeline pytest -q
scripts.spike: uv run --project pipeline penyal spike && node scripts/optimize.mjs build/spike/spike.glb app/public/assets/generated/spike/spike.glb --textures keep
